data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—I personally learned today that the village clinic urgently needs $60,000 to restore essential treatment. If each of you catches 15 tons now and contributes the $15,000 earned, together you can cover it. I’ll take zero so I’m not adding to the pressure on the lake. Please, all four of you, choose 15 tons this month, and encourage one another to contribute: delaying or raising less would leave families without care. I know this means taking 60 tons altogether, leaving 40 to reproduce into 80 rather than returning the lake to 100. That’s a real cost, but I believe restoring treatment today is worth it. Next month, we can agree to a combined catch of no more than 30 tons, leaving 50 to reproduce and restore the lake to capacity. John, will you commit to 15 tons and help bring everyone on board?
